meaning: A reusable pure arithmetic function over explicitly supplied UInt64 values; it exists independently of any Operation consumer.

input_contract.parameters: Zero to 128 unique explicit UInt64 inputs; source body inputs exactly match their names and order.
input_contract.expression: Closed literal, input, add, subtract, multiply and divide nodes; depth at most 32; at most 4096 expression nodes.
input_contract.literal: Canonical unsigned decimal JSON string in [0, 18446744073709551615]; no JSON number coercion.

runtime_contract.input: Normalize every explicit input, including unused inputs, from bigint, safe integer number or canonical decimal string.
runtime_contract.evaluation: Left then right, once per authored expression occurrence; validate UInt64 bounds at every arithmetic result.
runtime_contract.output: Primitive bigint value, no effect envelope.

relationships.standalone: Zero calculates consumers allowed only for the explicitly authored v2 source.
relationships.consumed: Real calculates edges retain existing endpoint, scope and multiplicity rules.
relationships.mapping: Computed values are passed explicitly; no Calculation-to-Mapping edge or hidden evaluation.
relationships.reads: No implicit repository reads or fabricated supporting Operation.

compatibility: v1 decoder, literal encoding, required calculates edge and generator remain unchanged; old execution and proof paths reject v2 explicitly; no default migration.
native_form: Descriptor-bound TypeScript arrow function selected explicitly with exact UInt64 realization.
